advice.classifier: Codex's automatic reviewer denied these or ran out of time. --examples 1 shows the reasons. Timeouts are not judgements; a retry or a person can still approve.
advice.sandbox: Codex's sandbox refused these. Widen writable_roots for that project, or run that work under a less strict sandbox.
advice.unknown: This version cannot place these. Please report the message text so a signature can be added.

signatures.pattern: ^This action was rejected due to unacceptable risk\.
^The automatic permission approval review did not finish before its deadline\.
